title: Rick NDE 9732
content: I was waiting for the property management to remove the beehive. They were taking too long to remove the hive, so I decided to remove it myself. I thought they were honey bees. Later on, I found out it was a killer beehive. The killer bees attack me and my neighbor. I called the 911, and the firefighters came shortly thereafter. The paramedic asked me if I wanted to go to the hospital because I looked swollen and hurt. I decided that I didn't need to go to the hospital. Iwent home and decided to take a shower and some pain pills. Then, I went to bed and was almost asleep. However, my brother's cat was meowing at me in a different tone. That led me stay to awake a bit longer. When I got up, I was experiencing anaphylactic shock, going in and out of consciousness. Then, I was in a dark void while using the restroom. I decided to go to bed and sleep it off. The cat started meowing in that different tone again, catching my brother's attention. He looked at me and then told me that we were going hospital. During the car ride, I felt tired. Due to the COVID-19 pandemic, it longer to admit me. During admittance, the nurse gave me a few shots for the bee sting attack and bee sting removal. Then, I went to the room waiting for medical clearance and observation. I closed my eyes and was transported into a world where desert and forest met. I was standing on a hill watching either a sunrise or sunset.It also felt like I was home or at peace. I felt there was no time. In reality, I was only there a short time. Once I woke up I felt like I had slept really well. Yet, after the experience, I was depressed because I wanted to back. At the same time, I had a different view of life. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 4/2020 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Uncertain Killer Bee Attack. Other: Poison from killer bee attack. Feeling tried, weakness, and in and out of consciousness. How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes Feeling at home. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. I felt the place was a part of me or like I was going back home in past or present. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I felt like there was no negative experience, only pure peace. Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. ??? Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Hearing experience was like a classic musical experience. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? Yes A place that is impossible to find on earth. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Some unfamiliar and strange place. Felt like I was on a different planet. What emotions did you feel during the experience? I am home. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt no longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? I remembered many past events. Reincarnation and places I lived during my travels. Did scenes from the future come to you? Scenes from my personal future Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a definite conscious decision to return to life. Nothing came to me. God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Unaffiliated- Agnostic Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Uncertain uncertain What is your religion now? No comment Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? Uncertain During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Uncertain Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Yes Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? Yes During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Moderate changes in my life After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I do not know how my remembrance of the experience compares to my remembrance of other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Uncertain Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? uncertain Have you ever shared this experience with others? No Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was probably real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? Yes Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? No Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? No

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Killer bee attack with anaphylactic shock ("poison from killer bee attack"), going in and out of consciousness.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Brief recall of past events and "reincarnation and places I lived during my travels"; scenes from personal future; hearing described as "a classic musical experience."

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Initially reported being in a "dark void" while using the restroom before later being "transported into a world where desert and forest met."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I closed my eyes and was transported into a world where desert and forest met.” “It also felt like I was home or at peace.” “I felt there was no time.” “Hearing experience was like a classic musical experience.”
